exposure: mode of birth (spontaneous labor, prelabor cesarean, instrumental vaginal birth)
outcome: women's perspectives on quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC)
cohort: 2079 women giving birth in healthcare facilities in Latvia between March 2020 and October 2021 participated in an online questionnaire.
finding: The study found significant perceived gaps in the quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC) in Latvia during the COVID-19 pandemic, with a significantly lower QMNC index reported in 2020 compared to 2021.
mod_finding: Among women who went into labor, 66.4% of those undergoing an instrumental vaginal birth received fundal pressure, and the study analyzed separate groups of women who went into labor versus those with a prelabor cesarean.
